call: FCT PTDC 2025 — R&D Projects in All Scientific Domains

A.name: Scientific merit and innovative nature

A1.name: Scientific merit of the project
dimensions: Relevance and clear identification of objectives and challenges based on state-of-the-art
Quality and adequacy of the proposed methodology
Potential contribution to advance knowledge in the field

A2.name: Innovative nature of the proposal
dimensions: Originality and ambition of the proposal
Potential for disruptive or transformative results
Positioning relative to international research frontiers

A.note: Criterion A assesses WHAT is proposed (merit, ambition, originality)

B.name: Scientific merit of the PI and the research team

B1.name: Scientific merit of the PI
dimensions_ICDT: Track record of scientific productivity and quality
dimensions_PEX: Track record relative to career stage
Impact of project on PI career development

B2.name: Research team
dimensions: Complementarity of skills and balance of roles
Adequacy of team size and composition for the work plan
Track record of collaboration and internationalization
Capacity to engage and develop early-career researchers

C.name: Feasibility of the workplan and budget adequacy
dimensions: Coherence and realism of the workplan and timeline
Clarity and tangibility of deliverables linked to each task
Budget adequacy, proportionality, and justification at task level
Quality of the management structure and risk management
Ethics compliance and timeline for approvals (when applicable)
Alignment between ambitious objectives (Criterion A) and available resources
C.note: Criterion C assesses HOW feasible the proposal is (planning, resources, implementation)

scoring.funding_decision: Ranked by overall score; funded until budget exhausted

lump_sum_rules.intermediate_payments: Only for tasks with 100% completion rate
